runtime_binding.entrypoint: Nine-node organism uses bounded node-specific runtimes; no monolithic second kernel runtime.
runtime_binding.source_of_truth: Repository source + deployed Supabase Edge source + persisted proof receipts; exact-current parity is node-specific and must be reread.

acceptance: A runtime is not considered living merely because this registry exists; behavioral, outcome, causal, production and successor proof are separate gates.

SELF.proof_boundary: Identity anchor exists; universal SELF behavioral influence across every task is not claimed.

LAW.proof_boundary: Deployed Edge source equals current repository source; prior bounded authorize/refuse proof exists. Latest-main end-to-end chain still requires fresh production proof.

ACT.proof_boundary: Deployed Edge source equals current repository source; bounded live ACT proof exists. Exact current multi-request/idempotency proof remains a separate rung.

KNOW.proof_boundary: Live function is active but deployed source does not equal current Graph V2 repository source. Do not claim current-main Graph V2 production behavior.

PROVE.proof_boundary: Deployed Edge source equals current repository source; bounded proof exists, but current full-chain outcome remains separately gated.

CONNECT.proof_boundary: Graph V2 contract is ratified and selector source merged. Live KNOW is stale to current source, so current Graph V2 influence is not production-proven.

VERIFY.proof_boundary: nayanet-causal-verify deployed source equals current repo; nayanet-learning-verify does not. Verification capability is bounded, not universal current-main proof.

LEARN.persisted_transitions: learning candidates + Intelligent Blocks + checkpoint/verification receipts
LEARN.proof_boundary: Live components exist, but current repository sources are not fully deployed. Learning claims still require verified future behavioral effect.

EVOLVE.proof_boundary: Bounded cold-successor evidence exists historically; current source parity is not fully established and no universal successor claim is made.

binding_truth_rule: Every one of the nine nodes must have exactly one canonical binding entry with an executable, persisted transition surface, and an explicit proof boundary. Binding existence is not proof of current-main production parity or universal behavioral influence.
